source_notes: Re-verified 2026-06 sweep: project remains PROPOSED. No FID, no EPC contract, no signed government agreement, no public capacity/start-year. ExxonMobil's equity participation still undecided. Nothing found that advances status beyond 'proposed' or that changes a GEM field.
